description.zh: 客户电话归属城市；为空表示全部，如"成都"，此参数需要URLEncode
description.en: The city of the customer's phone number. For example, `Chengdu`. If you leave this parameter empty, the system queries records from all cities. The value must be URL-encoded.

description.zh: 座席工号,此字段支持传入多个座席工号，使用英文半角逗号隔开
description.en: The agent ID. You can specify multiple agent IDs by separating them with commas (`,`).

description.zh: 查询结束时间；时间戳格式,精确到s。startTime与endTime不允许跨月，默认值取当前月份最后一天
description.en: The end of the query time range, specified as a Unix timestamp in seconds. The time range defined by `StartTime` and `EndTime` must be within the same calendar month. Default: The last day of the current month.

description.zh: 未进入队列原因 参数说明： 4: 无座席未进入队列 , 3: 队列满未进入队列
description.en: The reason for not entering the queue. Valid values:

description.zh: 离开队列原因 参数说明： 2: 队列中放弃 , 3: 队列中超时溢出 , 4: 队列中无座席溢出
description.en: The reason for leaving the queue. Valid values:

description.zh: 需要取出的数据条数；大于0，最大不能超过1000，默认10
description.en: The number of records to return on each page. The value must be an integer from 1 to 1,000. Default: `10`.

description.zh: 客户电话归属省份；为空表示全部，如"四川"，此参数需要URLEncode
description.en: The province of the customer's phone number. For example, `Sichuan`. If you leave this parameter empty, the system queries records from all provinces. The value must be URL-encoded.

description.zh: 队列号 参数说明：-1: 未进入队列
description.en: The queue ID. A value of `-1` indicates that the call did not enter a queue.

description.zh: 从第几条开始取；大于等于0，默认0
description.en: The offset for pagination. The value must be `0` or greater. Default: `0`.

description.zh: 查询开始时间；时间戳格式,精确到s。startTime与endTime不允许跨月，默认值取当前月份第一天
description.en: The start of the query time range, specified as a Unix timestamp in seconds. The time range defined by `StartTime` and `EndTime` must be within the same calendar month. Default: The first day of the current month.

description.zh: 呼叫结果；参数说明： 1:座席接听 2:已呼叫座席，座席未接听 3:系统接听 4:系统未接听-IVR配置错误 5:系统未接听-停机 6:系统未接听-欠费 7:系统未接听-黑名单 8:系统未接听-未注册 9:系统未接听-彩铃 11:系统未接听-呼叫超出营帐中设置的最大限制 12:系统未接听-客户呼入系统后在系统未应答前挂机 13:其他错误 14:未进入队列 15:队列中放弃 16:队列中超时溢出 17:队列中无座席溢出 18:无座席未进入队列 19:队列满未进入队列
查询时间开始结束范围生效类型；通话记录startTime和endTime时间范围生效类型，当startTime和endTime不为空时生效；取值：1.呼叫开始时间 2.呼叫结束时间； 默认为1
description.en: Specifies how the time range defined by `StartTime` and `EndTime` applies to the query. This parameter is used only when both `StartTime` and `EndTime` are specified. Valid values are `1` for call start time and `2` for call end time. Default: `1`.

description.zh: 如果uniqueId值不为空，则以下其它参数无效，即仅查询电话唯一标识为uniqueId的记录信息
description.en: If specified, the system ignores all other filter parameters and queries only the record that matches this unique ID.

description.zh: 用户自定义参数指定查询value；传递该参数时必须传递userFieldKey，仅查询一个字段，不支持模糊匹配， 构造的自定义字段查询条件为:{"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}，此参数需要URLEncode
description.en: The value of the custom field to use for filtering. You must also specify `UserFieldkey` if you use this parameter. Queries support only a single custom field. Fuzzy matching is not supported. The query condition is constructed in the format `{"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}`. The value must be URL-encoded.

description.zh: 用户自定义参数指定查询key；传递该参数时必须传递userFieldValue，仅查询一个字段，不支持模糊匹配， 构造的自定义字段查询条件为:{"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}，此参数需要URLEncode
description.en: The key of the custom field to use for filtering. You must also specify `UserFieldValue` if you use this parameter. Queries support only a single custom field. Fuzzy matching is not supported. The query condition is constructed in the format `{"userFieldkey":"userFieldvalue"}`. The value must be URL-encoded.
